heroHeadline: US Court Strikes Down Trump Visa Ban on South Asian Nations as Trump Approval Remains at Record Low
heroSubtitle: A Reuters/Ipsos poll concluding Monday, August 17, 2026 (Day 575) found Trump's approval at 33% approve / 64% disapprove — the lowest of his second term, tying his first-term low from December 2017 — with 80% of Americans, including 71% of Republicans, expecting the Iran war to drag on and rising gas prices weighing on his standing; for the first time in roughly a decade, more voters trust Democrats than Republicans on the economy. On August 16 (Day 574), Trump announced via Truth Social that he directed War Secretary Pete Hegseth to substantially cut back the annual Ulchi Freedom Shield exercises with South Korea, citing cost, a desire not to antagonize Kim Jong Un, and Seoul's refusal to help with US operations against Iran. On August 18 (Day 576), the Treasury Department proposed GENIUS Act regulations restricting stablecoin issuance to licensed entities starting July 2028. This follows the August 14 release of American missionary Kevin Rideout after nine months held captive in Niger, and Trump's August 14 order for the Navy to abandon EMALS and revert to steam catapults on its newest Ford-class carriers.
